summary: This SEC Form 8-K reports that on July 15, 2026, Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator, furnished a preliminary remarketing memorandum for the SLM Student Loan Trust 2005-7 Class A-5 Reset Rate Notes, a routine event in asset-backed securities administration. The filing describes a potential remarketing of up to $123,692,374 in notes on July 27, 2026, with all existing holders required to submit hold notices by July 22 or have notes deemed tendered. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, strategic review, or restructuring—this is a standard capital markets remarketing process.
